worldcombat.skill.roar.summary: Roar out a ring of sound that shakes every enemy in range into losing its target and leaving the fight; an opponent with a reserve is truly switched out, while wild or reserveless ones are only driven off. It deals no damage, it only drives them off.
worldcombat.skill.roar.use.0: Drive off the enemies crowding you all at once
worldcombat.skill.roar.use.1: Break a surround and buy yourself breathing room
worldcombat.skill.roar.use.2: Push a whole ring of opponents back in a melee
worldcombat.skill.roar.description.0: Shout out a %1$s block ring around yourself, laying about %2$s sound waves through it; the ring you see is exactly the edge of what gets caught.
worldcombat.skill.roar.description.1: Every enemy inside is marked Routed for %1$s seconds; while it lasts, anything closer than %2$s blocks is driven %3$s blocks away every 10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.roar.description.2: No damage: it only drives opponents out of the engagement and turns them away. Pokemon, vanilla mobs, modded creatures and players all take the same path.
worldcombat.skill.roar.unleash.on: Unleash on: the ring is x1.25 wider and the rout x1.15 longer, at the cost of +3 ticks of preparation and +20 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.roar.unleash.off: Unleash off: faster to come out, -10 ticks of cooldown and a narrower ring, good for repeated shoves.
worldcombat.skill.roar.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.roar.growth.0: At level %1$s the ring widens to %2$s blocks and the rout lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.roar.growth.1: At level %1$s the ring widens to %2$s blocks, the rout lasts %3$s seconds and the sound waves rise to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.roar.preference.unleas: On: ring x1.25 and rout x1.15, but +3 ticks of preparation and +20 of cooldown. Off: faster, shorter cooldown, narrower ring.
worldcombat.skill.roar.preference.ai.max: The companion only considers a roar when an enemy is within this distance; smaller means point-blank only, larger means it opens with it.
worldcombat.skill.roar.preference.ai.min: Only roar when at least this many enemies stand inside the ring; raise it to stay restrained and shout only into a crowd.
worldcombat.skill.roar.preference.ai.lea: On: it will leave its station under a hold order to roar. Off: it only does so when the enemies are already inside its ring.
world_combat.move.roar.text.miss: The roar fades into the air
